# Joel Martinez — push to main

> GTM engineer in Seattle. I help CEOs and revenue leaders (CROs, VPs of Sales and Marketing) model the market, segment it, and test their hypotheses in days, not quarters — then build the data and AI systems that keep it running. Ten years carrying a bag; builds with AI. Available for project, fractional, or embedded work.

## How I help revenue leaders

1. **Map the market** — TAM modeling and segmentation from real signals, tested in weeks.
2. **Build the source of truth** — accounts and customers in one place, synced to every channel; rep acceleration (call prep, briefs, warm-intro maps).
3. **Run what compounds** — outbound, paid, LinkedIn, ABM, and growth experiments that each sharpen the next.

Cold email is table stakes; it should run in the background. Work shipped in SaaS, healthcare, hardware, mineral rights, and M&A.
